about.title: About Us
about.storyText1: Brothers Shop was founded in 2015 by my brother, who had a vision to bring premium quality men's clothing at affordable prices to the people of Constantine.
about.storyText2: What started as a small shop in the heart of Rahba, Constantine, has grown into a trusted destination for men who appreciate style, quality, and value.
about.storyText3: From our humble beginnings, we've remained committed to our core belief: every man deserves to look and feel his best without breaking the bank.
about.valueQualityText: We source only the finest materials for lasting comfort and durability.
about.valuePriceText: Premium quality doesn't have to cost a fortune. We keep prices fair for everyone.
about.valueServiceText: Your satisfaction is our priority. We're here to help you find your perfect style.
about.physicalStore: Physical store open daily - Come visit us!
about.onlineAvailable: Also available online with fast delivery across Algeria

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I track my order?
faq.a1: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track your order in your account dashboard.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, and Apple Pay.
faq.a3: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days. Overnight shipping takes 1-2 business days.
faq.q4: Can I change or cancel my order?
faq.a4: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. Please contact customer service immediately.
faq.a5: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by location.
faq.a6: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unworn, unwashed items with original tags attached.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.infoCollectText: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, place an order, or contact customer service. This may include your name, email address, shipping address, and payment information.
privacy.useInfoText: We use your information to process orders, communicate with you about your order, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.securityText: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. All payment information is encrypted using SSL technology.
privacy.cookiesText: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze site traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@brothershop.com

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.freeShipping: We offer free standard shipping on all orders over 10000 DZD within Algeria.
shipping.processTime: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. You will receive a tracking number once your order ships.
shipping.returnText: We want you to love your purchase. If you're not completely satisfied, you may return unworn, unwashed items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
shipping.eligible: To be eligible for a return:
shipping.eligible1: Items must be unworn and unwashed
shipping.eligible2: Original tags must still be attached
shipping.eligible3: Items must be in original packaging
shipping.initiateReturn: To initiate a return, please contact our customer service team.
shipping.refundsText: Once we receive your return, we will inspect the item and process your refund within 5-7 business days. Refunds will be issued to your original payment method.

sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.description: Find your perfect fit with our size guide. All measurements are in centimeters.
sizeGuide.chestGuide: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape measure horizontal.
sizeGuide.waistGuide: Measure around your natural waistline, keeping the tape comfortably loose.
sizeGuide.hipGuide: Measure around the fullest part of your hips.
